name: 言犀智能体平台
desc: JD Cloud's agent and voice-interaction platform
desc_zh: 京东云的智能体与人机交互平台
solves: Chat bot, agent desk and outbound calling are three systems whose scripts never meet. Yanxi puts them on one platform: set the knowledge base and it goes live.
solves_zh: 客服、坐席、语音外呼各是一套系统，话术和接口互不相通。言犀把它们放进同一个平台，配好知识库就能上线。
best_for: A customer-service or outbound-call team that needs a bot live this quarter, not a research project.
best_for_zh: 客服或外呼团队要在本季度上线机器人，而不是做一个研究项目。
notes: 电商与供应链行业 Know-how 最深的智能体搭建平台，沉淀了一百余个行业方案模板 来源：https://finance.people.com.cn/n1/2024/0731/c1004-40289220.html
